English: The incidence of hepatotoxicity is life-threatening and can result to an end-stage liver disease in long-term patients on combined antiretroviral therapy (cART).
Luganda: Okukosebwa kw’ekibumba kutiisa nnyo era kusobola okuleetera ekibumba okufunira ddala obulwadde mu balwadde abakozesa eddagala erikkakkanya ku HIV (cART).
Yoruba: Bẹ́mìídíje ni àwọn ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ ògidi àìlera-ẹ̀dọ tí ó sì lè jásí ìpelè tí ó kẹ́yìn àrùn ẹ̀dọ̀ lára àwọn aláìsàn ọlọ́jọ́ pípẹ́ tí wọ́n ń ṣe ìkànpọ̀ ìtọ́jú ìkóràn adènàHIV (cART).
Zulu: Isifo sokungcola kwamaphaphu sibeka impilo yalabo esebenesikhathi eside bedla imishanguzo egcupheni, yokuhlaselwa isifo samaphaphu esingumnqamulajuqu (cART).
Hausa: Abun da yake faruwa na guba ga hanta abu ne mai barazana ga rayuwa kuma yana iya kawo cutar hanta ga masu amfani da magungunan jiyya na (cART) na tsawon lokaci.
Northern Sotho: Temogo ya hepathothoksisithi e ka baka mahu le go baka bolwetši bja sebete seo se senyegilego go balwetši ba kgale bao ba šomišago dihlare tša anthiretherobaerale ya mohlakanelwa (cART).
Amharic: የጉበት ዝለት ክስተት ለህይወት አስጊ ሲሆን ውህድ የጸረ-ኤችአይቪ ህክምናውን (ው.ጸ.ኤ.ህ) በመውሰድ የቆዩት ታማሚዎች ላይ የመጨረሻ-ደረጃ የጉበት በሽታን ሊያስከትል ይችላል፡፡

English: Our study sought to evaluate the incidence and predictors of cART-induced hepatotoxicity (CIH) among long term users on cART in a rural District hospital.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kwaffe kwagenderera okwekaliriza okugwawo kw’obulwadde wamu n’ebiteeberezebwa ku bulwadde bw’ekibumba obuleetebwa cART (CIH) mu bantu abaludde nga bakozesa cART mu ddwaliro mu Disitulikiti ey’omu kyalo.
Yoruba: Iṣẹ́ ìwádìí wa fẹ́ ṣàyẹ̀wò ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ àti àwọn ohun tí ó ń se àsọtẹ́lẹ̀ ògidi àìlera-ẹ̀dọ̀ ti cART (CIH) láàrin àwọn tí wọ́n ti ń lo cArt tipẹ́ ní ilé-ìwòsàn tí ó wà ní agbègbè ìgbèríko.
Zulu: Ucwaningo lwethu belufuna ukuhlola izehlakalo kanye nezibikezelo ze-cART-induced hepatotoxicity (CIH) phakathi kwabasebenzisi besikhathi eside be-cART esibhedlela Sesifunda sasemakhaya.
Hausa: Nazarinmu ya nemi kimanta abubuwan da suka faru da masu hasashen cART da suke haifar da cutar hanta (CIH) a tsakanin masu amfani da cART na tsawon lokaci a wani asibitin Gundumar karkara.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tša rena di be di nepile go lekola temogo le dikakanyo tša hephathothoksisithi ye e hlabetšwego ka cART (CIH) go badiriši ba kgale ba cART go sepetlele sa Selete sa dinagamagaeng.
Amharic: ጥናታችን በገጠር ወረዳ ሆስፒታል ውስጥ ባሉ የው.ጸ.ኤ.ህ የረዥም ጊዜ ተጠቃሚዎች መካከል በው.ጸ.ኤ.ህ ምክንያት የሚከሰተውን የጉበት ዝለት (ው.ም.ጉ.ዝ) አጋጣሚ እና ትንበያዎች ለመገምገም ሞክሯል፡፡

English: Spectrophotometric method was use for the quantitative measurement of alanine-aminotransferase (ALT) and aspartate-aminotransferase (AST) levels.
Luganda: Akakodyo k’okukebera eddagala kaakozesebwa okupima obungi n’ekigero kya alanine-aminotransferase (ALT) ne aspartate-aminotransferase (AST).
Yoruba: Ọgbọ́n-ìṣèwádìí tí ó nííṣe pẹ̀lú ìṣòdiwọ̀n-agbára oòrùn ni wọ́n láti ṣòdiwọ̀n aláròpọ̀ fún ìpele ìṣàyẹ̀wò-àìra-ẹ̀dọ̀ ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀pẹ̀pẹ̀ (ALT) àti ìṣàyẹ̀wò-àìlera-ẹ̀dọ̀ ọ́lọ́jọ́pípẹ́ (AST).
Zulu: Ukuqoqa ulwazi lenani lezinga le-alanine-aminotrasferase (ALT) kanye ne-asprtate-aminotransferase (AST) kusentshenziwe indlela yokuqoqa ulwazi, i-Spectrotometric.
Hausa: An yi amfani da hanyar Spectrophotometric domin auna ma’aunin alanine-aminotransferase (ALT) da kuma matakan aspartate-aminotransferase (AST).
Northern Sotho: Go šomišitšwe mokgwa wa sepektrofothometriki go dira tekolo ya khwanthithethifi ya dikelo tša alanine-aminotransferase (ALT) le aspartate-aminotransferase (AST).
Amharic: የስፔክትሮፎቶሜትሪክ ዘዴ ለአላኒን-አሚኖትራንስፈሬዝ (አላ.አ) እና ለአስፓርቴት-አሚኖትራንስፈሬዝ (አስ.አ) ደረጃዎች ቁጥር መለኪያነት ጥቅም ላይ ውሏል፡፡

English: Patients with elevations of both ALT and AST were considered CIH.
Luganda: Abalwadde abalina ALT, ne AST baatwalibwa okubeera n’obulwadde bw’ekibumba bwa CIH.
Yoruba: Ojú CIH ni wọ́n fi wo àwọn aláìsàn tí wọ́n ní ìgbésóké ALT àti AST.
Zulu: Iziguli ezinokuphakama kwakho kokubili i-ALT ne-AST zazibhekwa njenge-CIH.
Hausa: Marasa lafiya tare da haɓakar duka ALT da kuma AST an ɗauke su a matsayin CIH.
Northern Sotho: Balwetši bao ba nago le ditlhatlogo tša ALT le AST ka bobedi ba dirilwe ditlhahlobo tša CIH.
Amharic: አላ.አ እና አስ.አ ከፍ ብሎ የሚታይባቸው ታማሚዎች እንደ ው.ም.ጉ.ዝ ተቆጥረዋል፡፡

English: The Chi (χ2) square test, ANOVA and Kaplan Meier log-ranked/ survival analyses were used to analyse the data.
Luganda: Okugezesa kwa Chi (χ2) ANOVA ne Kaplan Meier log-ranked/ okwekaliriza kw’okuwona bye byakozesebwa okukenenula obubaka obwakuŋŋaanyizibwa.
Yoruba: Àyẹ̀wò Chi (χ2), ANOVA àti ìtúpalẹ̀ ti Kaplan Meier ni wọ́n fi tú data náà palẹ̀.
Zulu: Kusentshenziswe indlela yokuhlaziya ulwazi ka-ANOVA kanye noKaplan i-Chi (χ2) i-Meir log-ranked ukucubungula ulwazi oluqoqiwe.
Hausa: An yi amfani da gwajin murabba’in Chi (χ2), ANOVA da kuma nazarin ragi/ nazarin rayuwa na Kaplan Meier don tantance bayanan.
Northern Sotho: Go šomišitšwe diteko tša sekwere tša Chi (χ2), ANOVA le ditshekatsheko tša tlhopho ya lloko/ go phologa tša Kaplan Meier go sekaseka datha.
Amharic: የቺ (χ2) ካሬ ሙከራ፣ ANOVA እና ካፕላንሜየር የምዝገባ ማስታወሻ ደረጃ/ የትርፈት ትንተና መረጃውን ለመተንተን ጥቅም ላይ ውለዋል፡፡

English: Results Of the 350 participants enrolled [156 (44.6%) males and 194 (55.4%) females], aged 43.87 ± 0.79 years (range 20 – 84 years) included in this analysis, 26 (4.4%) experienced moderate CIH.
Luganda: Ebyava mu beetabi 350 abeetabamu [156 (44.6%) abasajja ne 194 (55.4%) abakazi], abalina emyaka egiri wakati wa 43.87 ± 0.79 (wakati w’emyaka 20 – 84) abatunuuliddwa mu kwekaliriza kuno, 26 (4.4%) baafuna obulwadde bw’ekibumba obw’ekigero CIH.
Yoruba: Èsì àwọn akópa 350 [[156 (44.6%) tí wọ́n jẹ́ akọ àti 194 (55.4%) tí wọ́n jẹ́ abo], ọjọ́-orí wà ní ẹni ọdún 43.87 ± 0.79 (ní gbèǹdéke ẹni ọdún 20 – 84) náà wà nínú ìtúpalẹ̀ yìí, 26 (4.4%) nínu wọn ni CIH wọn kò ga jù.
Zulu: Kusetshenziswe imiphumela yabesilisa abangu-350 (abangama- 44.6%) kanye nayebesifazane abangama-194 (abangama-55.4%) abasukela eminyakeni engu-20 kuya kwengu-84 ukuqhuba uncwaningo. kwabangu- 26 (abanga-4.4%) kutholakale alindlangile izinga lesifo samaphaphu (CIH) kubo.
Hausa: Sakamakon mutane 350 da suka shiga nazarin [156 (kashi 44.6%) maza da kuma mata194 (kashi 55.4%)], shekaru 43.87 ± 0.79 shekaru (zangon shekaru 20 – 84) sun shiga wannan nazari, 26 (kashi 4.4%) sun sami matsakaicin CIH.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo tša bakgathatema ba 350 ba banna bao ba ingwadišitšego ba [156 (44.6%) le basadi ba 194 (55.4%)], ba mengwageng ye 43.87 ± 0.79 (ba mengwageng ya magareng ga ye 20 – 84) bao ba akareditšwego ka tshekatshekong ye, ba 26 (4.4%) ba bile le CIH ya magareng.
Amharic: በዚህ ትንታኔ ከተካተቱት 350 ተሳታፊዎች ውስጥ [156 (44.6%) ወንዶች እና 194 (55.4%) ሴቶች] እድሜያቸው 43.87 ± 0.79 አመታት (በ20 – 84 አመት የእድሜ ክልል) በዚህ ትንታኔ ውስጥ ተጠቃለዋል፤26 (4.4%) ያህሉ መካከለኛ ው.ም.ጉ.ዝ አጋጥሟቸዋል፡፡

English: We observed 57 (16.3%), 62 (17.7%) and 238 (68%) elevated levels ALT + AST, ALT and AST respectively.
Luganda: Twekaliriza ebigero bya ALT + AST, ALT ne AST 57 (16.3%), 62 (17.7%) ne 238 (68%) mu nziriŋŋana eyo.
Yoruba: A ṣàkíyèsí ìpele ìgbéga 57 (16.3%), 62 (17.7%) àti 238 (68%) fún ALT + AST, ALT àti AST ní ṣísẹ̀-ǹ-tẹ̀lé.

Northern Sotho: Re lemogile dikelo tše di hlatlogilego tše 57 (16.3%), 62 (17.7%) le 238 (68%) tša ALT + AST, ALT le AST ka tatelano.

English: Two independent predictive factors of CIH were, the male sex and alcoholism during the study period.
Luganda: Ensonga ezaateeberezebwa ng’ezireeta obulwadde bwa CIH mwalimu, ekikula ekisajja n’okunywa omwenge mu kiseera ky’okunoonyereza.
Yoruba: Àwọn ohun àsọtẹ́lè CIH tí wọ́n wà lọ́tọ̀ọ̀tọ̀ méjì náà ni, ti akọ àti ọtí mímu lásìkò ìwádìí.

English: The prevalence of CIH in HIV-infected patients in Bali was lower than that observed in previous studies.
Luganda: Okubaawo kw’obulwadde bw’ekibumba (CIH) mu balwadde ba HIV mu Bali kwali wansi ku okwo okwazuulibwa mu kunoonyereza okwayita.
Yoruba: Ìjẹyọ CIH lára àwọn tí wọ́n ní àrùn HIV ní Bali kéré sí ti àwọn tí wọ́n ṣàkíyèsí nínú àwọn ìwádìí tí wọ́n ti ṣe sẹ́yìn.

Northern Sotho: Go ata ga bolwetši bja CIH go balwetši bao ba nago le phetetšo ya HIV go la Bali go bile fasana ge go bapetšwa le seo se lemogilwego go dinyakišišo tša peleng.

English: The duration of therapy had no influence on the frequency of CIH.
Luganda: Ebbanga ly’obujjanjabi teryalina kakwate na CIH.
Yoruba: Àkókó tí ìtọ́jú fi ń lò kò kó ipa kankan lórí àlòtúnlò CIH.
Zulu: Ubude besikhathi sokwelashwa kwakungesiyo imbangela yeCIH.
Hausa: Tsawon lokacin jiyya ba shi da tasiri a kan yawan CIH.
Northern Sotho: Nako yeo kalafi e e tšerego ga se ya ba le khuetšo go ditiragalo tša kgafetšakgafetša tša CIH.
Amharic: የህክምናው የቆይታ ጊዜ በው.ም.ጉ.ዝ ድግግሞሽ ላይ ምንም ተጽእኖ አልነበረውም፡፡

English: Alcoholism and smoking showed significant differences in the development of CIH.
Luganda: Okunywa omwenge n’okunywa sigala kwayoleka enjawulo ya maanyi mu nkulaakulana ya CIH.
Yoruba: Ọtí líle mímu àti fífa nǹkan fi ìyàtọ̀ tí ó hàn gedengbe hàn nínú ìgbéǹde CIH.
Zulu: Ukudakwa nokubhema kubonise umehluko omkhulu ekuthuthukisweni kwe-CIH.

English: The rate of liver damage in HIV patients due to combinational ARVs (Anti-Retroviral Therapies) is lower in the Bali hospital district, Cameroon, compared to previous studies.
Luganda: Ekigero ky’okukosebwa kw’ekibumba mu balwadde ba HIV nga kiva ku nkozesa ya ARVs (eddagala erikkakkanya ku HIV) ery’enjawulo kiri wansiko mu ddwaliro ly’omu Disitulikiti y’e Bali, Cameroon bw’ogeraageranya n’okunoonyereza okwasooka.
Yoruba: Ìwọn àìlera ẹ̀dọ̀ lára àwọn aláìsàn tí wọ́n ní HIV tí ó sì tara àlòpọ̀ ARVs (ìtọ́jú-àìlera adènàHIV) kò pọ̀ ni ilé-ìwòsàn ti agbègbè Bali, bí a bá fi wé ti àọn ìwádìí tí wọ́n ti ṣe sẹ́yìn.
Zulu: Izinga lokulimala kwesibindi ezigulini ezine-HIV ngenxa yama-ARVs ayinhlanganisela (Anti-Retroviral Therapies) liphansi esifundeni sase-Bali esibhedlela, e-Cameroon, uma kuqhathaniswa nezifundo zangaphambilini.
Hausa: Yawan lalacewar hanta a tsakanin masu HIV saboda haɗa magungunan MCƘ (Magungunan Cutar Ƙanjamau) ya ragu a asibitin gundumar Bali ta Kamaru, idan aka kwatanta da binciken da aka yi a baya.
Northern Sotho: Kelo ya tshenyego ya sebete go balwetši ba HIV ka lebaka la di-ARV (Dihlare tša Anthiretherobaerale) tša mohlakanelwa e fasana go sepetlele sa selete sa Bali, Cameroon, ge go bapetšwa le dinyakišišo tše di fetilego.
Amharic: በካሜሩን በባሊ ሆስፒታል ወረዳ ውስጥ በውህድ ጸ.ኤ.ህ ምክንያት (ጸረ-ኤችአይቪ ህክምናዎች) በኤችአይቪ በሽተኞች ውስጥ ያለው የጉበት ጉዳት ደረጃ ከቀደምት ጥናቶች ጋር ሲነጻጸር አነስተኛ ነው፡፡

English: However, gender, consumption of alcohol and smoking influences the risk for liver damage in HIV patients.
Luganda: Wabula, ekikula, okunywa omwenge n’okunywa sigala birina akakwate n’okukosebwa kw’ekibumba mu balwadde ba HIV.
Yoruba: Àmọ́ ṣá, ìṣakọṣabo, ọtí líle mímu àti fífa nǹkan ń kó ipa lórí ewu ṣíṣàkóbá àìlera fún ẹ̀dọ̀ fún àwọn aláìsàn àrùn HIV.
Zulu: Nakube kunjalo ubulili, ukuphuza utshwalwa kanye nokubhema ugwayi kubeka labo abane-HIV ungcupheni yokuhlaselwa ukukhahlamezeka kwesibindi.
Hausa: Ko yaya, jinsi da shan barasa da kuma shan taba suna tasirin haɗarin lalacewar hanta ga masu HIV.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjalo, bong, go nwa bjala le go kgoga motsoko di na le khuetšo go tshenyego ya sebete go balwetši ba HIV.
Amharic: ይሁን እንጂ ጾታ ፣አልኮል መጠጣት፣እና ማጨስ  በኤችአይቪ በሽተኞች ላይ የጉበት ጉዳት የማድረስ ተጽእኖ አላቸው፡፡

English: Sub-Saharan Africa represents more than half of the HIV cases worldwide.
Luganda: Ebitundu bya Afirika ebiri wansi w’eddungu Sahara birimu abalwadde abasukka mu kitundu ky’abo abalina HIV mu nsi yonna.
Yoruba: Apá gúúsù Sahara ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà ni ó ni ìdá tí ó ju ààbọ̀ lọ nínú gbogbo ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ àrùn HIV lágbàáyé.
Zulu: Emazweni ase-Afrika akwi-Sub-Saharan izinga le-HIV lisabalele okudlula uhhafu nangaphezulu emhlabeni wonke jikelele.
Hausa: Yankin Afrika Kudu da Sahara na wakiltar fiye da rabin masu ɗauke da HIV a duniya.
Northern Sotho: Dinaga tša borwa bja Afrika di itemogela malwetši ao a fetago seripagare a HIV lefaseng ka bophara.
Amharic: በአለም ዙሪያ ከግማሽ በላይ የሚሆኑትን የኤችአይቪ ጥቃቶች ከሳሃራ በታች ያሉትን የአፍሪካ ሃገራት ይወክላሉ፡፡

English: Combinational HIV drugs are the recommended treatment, however its effects cause liver damage in patients.
Luganda: Eddagala lya HIV ery’enjawulo erikozesebwa okumu bwe bujjanjabi obusembebwa, wabula okukosebwa okuva ku ddagala eryo kuleeta okukosebwa kw'ekibumba mu balwadde.
Yoruba: Ìkànpọ̀ àwọn oògùn àrùn HIV ni ìtọ̀jú tí wọ́n yàn, àmọ́ ìlò rẹ̀ a máa fa àìlera ẹ̀dọ̀ lára àwọn aláìsàn.
Zulu: Imishanguzo yokuthiba i-HIV igunyaziwe, nakuba kunjalo iphinda ibe imbangela yesifo sokukhahlamezeka kwesindi ezigulini.
Hausa: Haɗin magungunan HIV shi ne magani da aka bayar da shawara, duk da haka tasirinsa yana haifar da lalacewar hanta a tsakanin marasa lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Go šišinywa gore go šomišwe dihlare tša HIV tša mohlakanelwa, le ge go le bjalo, ditlamorago tša tšona di baka tshenyego ya sebete go balwetši.
Amharic: ወሁድ የኤችአይቪ መድሃኒቶች የሚመከሩ ህክምናዎች ቢሆኑም ውጤታቸው ግን ለታማሚዎች የጉበት መጎዳት ምክንያት ነው፡፡

English: Not many studies focus on liver damage by ARVs however, so more data on this is needed.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza si kungi okutunuulira okukosebwa kw'ekibumba nga kuva ku ARVs, wabula, obubaka obukwata ku nsonga eno bwetaagibwa.
Yoruba: Ọpọ̀ ìwádìí kò dojú kọ àìlera ẹ̀dọ̀ tí àwọn ARV fà, àmọ́ a ṣì nílò dátà síi nípa èyí.
Zulu: Aluluningi uncwaningo olugxile ekukhulumeni ngesifo sokhahlameza kwesibindi esidalwa ama-ARV, ngakhoke kumele lwandiswe ulwazi oluphathalene nale simo.
Hausa: Yawancin bincike ba su mayar da hankali a kan lalacewar hanta da magungunan MCƘ suka haifar ba, don haka ana buƙatar ƙarin bayanai a kan wannan.
Northern Sotho: Ga se dinyakišišo tše ntši tše di beago šedi go tshenyego ya sebete ka di-ARV, ka gona go hlokega datha ye ntši mabapi le se.
Amharic: በጸ.ኤ.ህ የሚደርስ የጉበት ጉዳት ላይ የሚያተኩሩ ብዙ ጥናቶች  የሉም ስለዚህ በዚህ ላይ ተጨማሪ መረጃ ያስፈልጋል፡፡

English: The scientists wanted to find out how many people in the area were HIV positive with liver damage.
Luganda: Bannassaayansi baayagala okuzuula omuwendo gw’abantu abali mu kitundu omuli abantu abalina HIV era nga baakosebwa n’ekibumba.
Yoruba: Àwọn onímọ̀ sáyẹ́nsì náà fẹ́ tọpinpin iye ènìyàn tí tí ó ní àrùn HIV àti àìlera ẹ̀dọ̀ ní agbègbè náà.
Zulu: Ososayensi babefunda ukuthola inani labantu abanesifo sokhahlazeka kwesibindi ngenxa yokuphiala ne-HIV.
Hausa: Masana kimiyyar sun so su gano adadin mutanen yankin da suke ɗauke da ƙwayar HIV tare da lalacewar hanta.
Northern Sotho: Ditsebi tša mahlale di be di nyaka go utolla gore ke batho ba bakae ka tikologong bao ba bego ba na le HIV le sebete seo se senyegilego.
Amharic: ሳይንቲስቶቹ በአካባቢው የጉበት ጉዳት ያለባቸው የኤችአይቪ ተጠቂ ሰዎች ምን ያህል እንደሆኑ ማወቅ ፈልገው ነበር፡፡

English: They also wanted to find out which lifestyle habits increase the risk of liver damage in these patients.
Luganda: Era baayagala okuzuula eneeyisa eziyinza okwongera ku buzibu bw’okukosebwa ekibumba mu balwadde.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún fẹ́ wádìí ìwà ìlànà ìgbé-ayé wo ni ó ń ran ewu àìlera ẹ̀dọ̀ lọwọ lára àwọn aláìsàn yìí.
Zulu: Baphinde bafuna ukuthola ukuthi iyiphi imikhuba yokuphila eyandisa ubungozi bokulimala kwesibindi kulezi ziguli.
Hausa: Sun kuma so su gano ko wane irin salon rayuwa ne yake ƙara haɗarin lalacewar hanta a tsakanin waɗannan marasa lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Ba be ba nyaka le go utolla gore ke mehuta efe ya ditlwaelo tša bophelo yeo e oketšago kotsi ya tshenyego ya sebete go balwetši bao.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም የትኞቹ የአኗኗር ዘይቤዎች በእነዚህ ታማሚዎች ላይ የጉበት ጉዳትን ስጋት እንደሚጨምሩ ማወቅ ፈልገው ነበር፡፡

English: The researchers studied Bali district hospital patients who were HIV positive and older than 18 years.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baanoonyereza ku balwadde mu ddwaliro ly’omu Disitulikiti y’e Bali abaalina HIV era nga basussa emyaka 18.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà tọpinpin àwọn aláìsàn ilé-ìwòsàn agbègbè Bali tí wọ́n ni àrùn HIV tí wọn kò sì ju ẹni ọdún 18 lọ.
Zulu: Abancwaningi bahlola iziguli esibhedlela iBali ezine-HIV ezazinemnyaka engu-18 nangaphezulu.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun yi nazari a kan majinyatan asibitin gundumar Bali waɗanda suke ɗauke da ƙwayar HIV kuma ‘yan sama da shekaru 18.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba dirile diphatišišo ka balwetši ba sepetlele sa selete sa Bali bao ba bego ba na le HIV ba mengwaga ye e fetago ye 18.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በባሊ ወረዳ ሆስፒታል ያሉትን እና ከ18 አመት በላይ የሆናቸውን የኤችአይቪ ተጠቂ ታካሚዎች አጥንተዋል፡፡

English: Blood samples were collected from all patients, and they checked if certain proteins that are linked to liver damage were present or not.
Luganda: Sampolo z’omusaayi zaggyibwa ku balwadde bonna, era ne bakebera ebika bya puloteyini ebimu ebyekuusa ku kukosebwa kw’ekibumba oba nga byalimu oba tebyalimu.
Yoruba: Wọ́n gba ẹ̀jẹ̀ láara gbogbo àwọn aláìsàn fún àyẹ̀wò, wọ́n sì ṣe àyẹ̀wò bóyá àwọn potéènì tí wọ́n níi ṣe pẹ̀lú àìlera ẹ̀dọ̀ wà níbẹ̀ àbí wọn kò sí.
Zulu: Kwathathwa amasampuli amagazi kuzo zonke iziguli, ukuze kubhekwe ukuthi awanawo yini amaprotheni ayimbangela yesifo sokukhahlamezeka kwesibindi.
Hausa: An tattara samfuran jini daga duk marasa lafiya, kuma sun bincika ko akwai wasu furotoci da suke da alaƙa da lalacewar hanta ko a'a.
Northern Sotho: Go kgobokeditšwe disampole tša madi go balwetši ka moka, ebile go lekotšwe le go ba gona goba go se be gona ga diprotheine tšeo di amantšhwago le tshenyego ya sebete.
Amharic: የደም ናሙናዎች ከሁሉም ታካሚዎች ተወስደው ነበር፤ እናም ከጉበት ጉዳት ጋር የተያያዙ አንዳንድ ፕሮቲኖች መሮር አለመኖራቸውን አጣርተዋል፡፡

English: They then used computer modelling to predict which lifestyle factors are linked to liver damage.
Luganda: Olwo ate ne bakozesa entetenkanya ya kompyuta okuteebereza enneeyisa ezeekwanya ku kukosebwa kw’ekibumba.
Yoruba: Wọ́n wá ṣàmúlò módẹ́ẹ̀li ẹlẹ́rọ kọ̀m̀pútà láti se àsọtẹ́lè àwọn ìlànà ìgbé-ayé tí ó lè ṣòkùnfa àìlera ẹ̀dọ̀.
Zulu: Babe sebesenzisa indlela yokuncwaninga usikompilo leziguli ngekhompuyutha ukuze bakwazi ukuqangula lezo zinto ezinomthelela ekudalekeni kwesifo sokukhahlaka kwesibindi.
Hausa: Daga nan sai suka yi amfani da samfurin kwamfuta domin tantance ko wane irin salon rayuwa ne yake da alaƙa da lalacewar hanta.
Northern Sotho: Ke moka ba šomiša mmotlolo wa khomphutha go akanya gore ke dintlha dife tša ditlwaelo tša bophelo tšeo di amanywago le tshenyego ya sebete.
Amharic: ከዚያም የትኞቹ የአኗኗር ዘይቤ ምክንያቶች ከጉበት ጉዳት ጋር ተያያዥነት እንዳላቸው ለመተንበይ የኮምፒዩተር ሞዴሊንግ ተጠቅመዋል፡፡

English: The researchers confirmed that the levels of proteins that indicate liver damage were higher in HIV positive patients.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baakakasa nti ebigero bya puloteyini ebiraga okukosebwa kw’ekibumba byali waggulu ddala mu balwdde ba HIV.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí fìdìí rẹ̀ múlẹ̀ pé iye potéènì tí ó ń ṣàfihàn àìlera ẹ̀dọ̀ pọ̀ lára àwọn aláìsàn tí wọ́n ní àrùn HIV.
Zulu: Abancwaningi bathola ukuthi izinga lamaprotheni ayizinkomba zokukhahlamezeka kwesibindi eziguleni ezine-HIV liphezulu kakhulu.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun tabbatar da cewa matakan furotoci da suke nuna lalacewar hanta sun fi girma a cikin masu ɗauke da HIV.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba tiišeditše gore dikelo tša diprotheine tšeo di laetšago tshenyego ya sebete di be di le godimo go balwetši bao ba nago le HIV.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በኤችአይቪ ተጠቂ ታካሚዎች ውስጥ የጉበት ጉዳትን የሚያመላክቱ ፕሮቲኖች መጠን ከፍተኛ እንደሆነ አረጋግጠዋል፡፡

English: Their work also showed how certain HIV treatments were linked to higher levels of these proteins.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kwabwe era kwalaga engeri obujjanjabi bwa HIV obumu gye bwekwanya ku bigero bya puloteyini ebyo.
Yoruba: Iṣẹ́ wọn tún ṣàfihàn rẹ̀ bí àwọn ìtọ́jú àrùn HIV kọ̀ọ̀kan ṣe rọ̀ mọ́ ìpèle gíga àwọn potéènì wọ̀nyí.
Zulu: Ucwaningo lwabo lwaphinde laveza nokuthi emishanguzweni eminingi yokuthiba i-HIV luningi ngokwedlulele loluhlobo lwamaproteion.
Hausa: Har ila yau, aikinsu ya nuna yadda wasu magungunan HIV suke da alaƙa da manyan matakan waɗannan furotoci.
Northern Sotho: Mošomo wa bona o laeditše gape ka moo dihlare tše dingwe tša HIV di bego di amantšhwa le dikelo tša godimo tša diprotheine tše.
Amharic: አንዳንድ የኤችአይቪ ህክምናዎች ከእነዚህ ፕሮቲኖች በከፍተኛ ደረጃ መገኘት ጋር እንዴት እንደተያያዙም  ስራቸው አሳይቷል፡፡

English: Their computer modelling revealed that men who take ARVs are at a higher risk of liver damage, as well as people who consume alcohol and smoke.
Luganda: Entetenkanya yaabwe eya kompyuta yayoleka nti abasajja abakozesa ARVs bali mu bulabe bwa maanyi obw’okukosebwa kw’ekibumba, era nga bwe guli ne ku abo abanywa omwenge n’okufuuweeta sigala.
Yoruba: Módẹ́ẹ̀lì ẹlẹ́rọ kọ̀m̀pútà tún fi hàn pé àwọn ọkùnrin tí wọ́n ń gba ARV wà nínú ewu àìlera ẹ̀dọ̀ tí ó ga, àti àwọn ènìyàn tí wọ́n ń mu ọtí àti àwọn tí wọ́n ń fa nǹkan sínú.
Zulu: Uncwaningo abalenza ngekhomputha lwaphinde lwaveza ukuthi abesilisa abadla ama-ARVs basesigcupheni enkulu yokuphathwa isifo sokukhahlaka kwesibindi, nalabo abaphuzayo kanye nababhemayo.
Hausa: Samfurinsu na kwamfuta ya nuna cewa maza masu shan magungunan MCƘ suna cikin haɗarin lalacewar hanta, da kuma mutanen da ke shan barasa da kuma taba.
Northern Sotho: Mmotlolo wa bona wa khomphutha o utollotše gore banna bao ba nwago di-ARV ba lebane le kotsi ye kgolo ya go senyega ga sebete, gammogo le batho bao ba nwago bjala le go kgoga.
Amharic: የኮምፒዩተር ሞዴሊንጋቸውም ጸ.ኤ.ህ የሚወስዱ፣ አልኮል የሚጠጡ፣እንዲሁም  ያሚያጨሱ ሰዎች ለጉበት ጉዳት በከፍተኛ ደረጃ ተጋላጭ እንደሆኑ  አሳይቷል፡፡

English: It was already known that HIV positive patients have a risk of liver damage because of the treatments that they take.
Luganda: Kyali kimanyiddwa nti abalwadde abalina HIV baali mu buzibu bw’okufuna okukosebwa kw’ekibumba olw’obujjanjabi bwe bafuna.
Yoruba: Ohun tí ó ti di mímọ̀ tẹ́lẹ̀ ni pé ewu àwọn aláìsàn tí wọ́n ní àrùn HIV láti ni àìlera ẹ̀dọ̀ pọ̀ torí àwọn ìtọ́jú tí wọ́n ń gbà.
Zulu: Ukuba sengcupheni yokhahlamezeka kwesibindi kwabane-HIV kwakwaziwa ukuthi kubangwa imishanguzo abanikwa yona.
Hausa: TTuni an riga an san cewar masu ɗauke da HIV suna da haɗarin lalacewar hanta saboda magungunan da suke sha.
Northern Sotho: Go be go šetše go tsebja gore balwetši bao ba nago le HIV ba lebane le kotsi ya go senyega ga sebete ka lebaka la dihlare tšeo ba di nwago.
Amharic: የኤችአይቪ ተጠቂ ታማሚዎች በሚወስዷቸው ህክምናዎች ምክንያት ለጉበት ጉዳት ሊጋለጡ እንደሚችሉ አስቀድሞ ይታወቅ ነበር፡፡

English: However, this study looked at the rate at which HIV patients experience liver damage at the Bali District Hospital.
Luganda: Wabula, okunoonyereza kuno kwatunuulira ekigero abalwadde ba HIV kwe bafunira okukosebwa kw’ekibumba mu Ddwaliro ly’omu Disitulikiti y’e Bali.
Yoruba: Àmọ́ ṣá, ìwádìí yìí wo gbèdéke tí àwọn aláìsàn àrùn HIV fi ń ní àìlera ẹ̀dọ̀ ní Ilé-ìwòsàn Agbègbè Bali.
Zulu: Nokho, lolu cwaningo lubheke izinga iziguli ze-HIV ezizwa ngato ukulinyalelwa yisibindi esibhedlela sesifundankantolo i-Bali.
Hausa: Duk da haka, wannan binciken ya yi la’akari da yadda masu HIV ke samun lalacewar hanta a asibitin gundumar Bali.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjalo, dinyakišišo tše di lebeletše kelo yeo balwetši ba HIV ba itemogelago tshenyego ya sebete go Sepetlele sa Selete sa Bali.
Amharic: ይሁን እንጂ ይህ ጥናት በባሊ ወረዳ ሆስፒታል ያሉ የኤችአይቪ ታማሚዎች በየትኛው ደረጃ የጉበት ጉዳት እንደሚያጋጥማቸው ተመልክቷል፡፡

English: The researchers also found that drinking alcohol and smoking puts HIV patients at a higher risk for liver damage.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza era baazuula nti okunywa omwenge ne sigala kussa abalwadde ba HIV mu bulabe bwa maanyi obw’okukosebwa ekibumba.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí tún rí i pé mímu ọtí léle àti fífa ǹǹkan sínú ń fi àwọn aláìsàn àrùn HIV sínú ewu àìlera ẹ̀dọ̀ ńlá.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathola nokuthi ukuphuza utshwala nokubhema kubeka abantu abane-HIV engozeni ebucayi yokukhahlamezeka kwesibindi.
Hausa: Haka nan masu binciken sun kuma gano cewa shan barasa da shan taba na sanya masu HIV cikin haɗarin lalacewar hanta.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba hweditše le gore go nwa bjala le go kgoga motsoko go bea balwetši ba HIV kotsing ya godimo ya tshenyego ya sebete.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ አልኮል መጠጣት እና ማጨስ የኤችአይቪ ታማሚዎችን ለከፍተኛ የጉበት ጉዳት እንደሚያጋልጣቸው ደርሰውበታል፡፡

English: The researchers caution that patient data may be a limitation in this study.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza balabula nti obubaka obukwata ku balwadde buyinza okuba ekikugira mu kunoonyereza kuno.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí pè fún ìṣóra pé dátà àwọn aláìsàn lè fa ìdíwọ́ fún ìwádìí yìí.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bakubalula ukushoda kolwazi olugcwele ngesimo seziguli ngokuba umthelela onganciphisa olwazi oncwaningeni.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun yi gargaɗin cewa bayanan marasa lafiya na iya zama iyakancewa a wannan binciken.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba lemoša gore datha ya balwetši e ka baka ditšhitišo ka dinyakišišong tše.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በዚህ ጥናት ውስጥ የታካሚ መረጃ ገደብ ሳይኖር እንዳልቀረ ያስጠነቅቃሉ፡፡

English: They didn’t consider all factors, such as the use of other drugs besides HIV treatments.
Luganda: Tebaatunuulira nsonga zonna gamba ng’okukozesa eddagala eddala ng’oggyeeko eryo erijjanjaba HIV.
Yoruba: Wọn kò fi ti àwọn ohun mìíràn bíi kí wọ́n máa lo òògùn mìíràn tí kì í ṣe fún ìtọ́jú àrùn HIV ṣe.
Zulu: Abazibhekanga ezinye izimbangela, njengokusetshenziswa kweminye imihlomo yemishanguzo okungasiyo eyokuthiba i-HIV.
Hausa: Ba su yi la’akari da duk abubuwan ba, kamar amfani da wasu magunguna baya ga maganin HIV.
Northern Sotho: Ga se ba lekodišiša dintlha ka moka, tše bjalo ka tšhomišo ya diokobatši tše dingwe ntle le dihlare tša HIV.
Amharic: ከኤችአይቪ ህክምናዎች በተጨማሪ ሌሎች መድሃኒቶችን እንደመጠቀም ያሉትን ሁሉንም ሁኔታዎች ከግምት ውስጥ አላስገቡም፡፡

English: Also, since the population used for this study was different from other studies in terms of age and sex, the conclusions don’t necessarily agree with other studies from Africa.
Luganda: Mu ngeri y’emu, olw’okuba abantu abaakozesebwa mu kunoonyereza kuno baali banjawulo okuva ku abo abaali mu kunoonyereza okwasooka mu myaka ne mu kikula, ebyatuukibwako tebikkaanya butereevu n’ebyo ebyali mu kunoonyereza okwakolebwa mu Afirika.
Yoruba: Àti pé, níwọ̀n ìgbà tí ó jẹ́ pé iye òǹkà-olùgbé tí a lò fún iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí yàtọ̀ sí ti àwọn ìwádìí mìíràn nípa ọjọ́-orí àti ìṣakọṣabo, àwọn ìpinnu rẹ̀ kò bá ti àwọn ìwádìí mìíràn ní ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà mu.
Zulu: Ngenxa yokuthi iqeqeba labantu abasentshenziswe kulolu ncwaningo bahlukile ngokweminyaka nobulile, lokho kwenza isiphetho sayo singavumelani nokushiwo abanye abacwaningi bakwamanye amazwe ase-Africa.
Hausa: Har ila yau, tun da yawan jama’ar da aka yi amfani da su don wannan binciken ya bambanta da sauran nazarin ta fuskar shekaru da kuma jinsi, ba lallai ne sakamakon ya zamo ɗaya da sauran nazari daga Afirka ba.
Northern Sotho: Le gona, ka ge bakgathatema bao ba šomišitšwego go dinyakišišo tše ba fapana le ba dinyakišišo tše dingwe go ya ka mengwaga le bong, diphetho ga di tloge di dumelelana le dinyakišišo tše dingwe go tšwa ka Afrika.
Amharic: እንዲሁም ለዚህ ጥናት ጥቅም ላይ የዋለው የህዝብ አይነት ከሌሎች ጥናቶች ጋር ሲነጻጸር እድሜን እና ጾታን አስመልክቶ የተለየ በመሆኑ፣ ድምዳሜው ሌሎች በአፍሪካ ከተደረጉ ጥናቶች ጋር ላይስማማ  ይችላል፡፡

English: This study focused on one hospital in Cameroon and the findings should be confirmed in future research in other regions.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kwakolebwa ku ddwaliro limu mu Cameroon era ebyatuukibwako biteekwa okukakasibwa mu kunoonyereza okw’omu maaso okuva mu bitundu ebirala.
Yoruba: Iṣẹ́ ìwádìí náà dojú kọ ilé-ìwòsàn kan ní Cameroon, wọn yóò sì fìdíi àbọ̀ ìwádìí múlẹ̀ nínú àwọn ìwádìí tí wọn yóò se lọ́jọ́-iwáju ní àwọn agbègbè mìíràn.
Zulu: Lolu cwaningo belugxile esibhedlela esisodwa ezweni lase-Cameroon kanti okutholiwe komele kuqinisekiswe ocwaningweni lwangomusa kwezinye izifunda.
Hausa: Wannan binciken ya mayar da hankali ne ga wani asibiti a ƙasar Kamaru kuma ya kamata a tabbatar da sakamakon binciken a bincike na gaba a wasu yankuna.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše di be di dirilwe sepetleleng se tee nageng ya Cameroon, ka gona dikutollo di swanetše go tiišetšwa go dinyakišišo tša ka moso ka dileteng tše dingwe.
Amharic: ይህ ጥናት በካሜሩን በአንድ ሆስፒታል ላይ ያተኮረ ሲሆን ግኝቶቹ በሌሎች ክልሎች ወደፊት በሚደረጉ ጥናቶች መረጋገጥ አለባቸው፡፡

English: Africa has a high burden of HIV.
Luganda: Afirika erina ekibizu kya HIV kya maanyi nnyo.
Yoruba: Àjàgà-ẹrù arun HIV pọ̀ lọ́rùn ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà.
Zulu: I-HIV uwumthwalo omkhulu ezwenikazi lase-Afrika.
Hausa: Afirka tana da babbar matsalar HIV.
Northern Sotho: Afrika e lebane le mathata a magolo a HIV.
Amharic: አፍሪካ ከፍተኛ የኤችአይቪ ጫና አለባት፡፡

English: This study by Cameroonian researchers sheds light on important data showing the incidence of liver damage in HIV patients, and the different factors increase their risk for liver damage.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno okwakolebwa abanoonyereza b’omu cameroon kutusiigira ekifaananyi ku bubaka obw’omugaso ddala ku kubaawo kw’okukosewa kw’ekibumba mu balwadde ba HIV, wamu n’ensonga ez’enjawulo ezongera obulabe bw’okukosebwa kw’ekibumba.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí tí àwọn aṣèwádìí ilẹ̀ Cameroon ṣe yìí tan ìmọ́lẹ̀ sí àwọn data pàtàkì tí wọ́n ń ṣàfihàn àìlera ẹ̀dọ lára àwọn tí wọ́n ní àrùn HIV, àti pé àwọn ohun mìíràn náà tún ń se àlékún ewu àìlera ẹ̀dọ̀.
Zulu: Lolu cwaningo oludidiyelwe abacwaningi base-Cameroon lukhanyisa iminingo ebicashile, ephathelene nokuvama kwesifo sokhahlamezeka kwesibindi sabaphila ne-HIV, luphinde luveze izimbangela ezihlukahlukene ezandisa ubungozi bokuba sengcupheni yokuhlaselwa ile sifo.
Hausa: Wannan binciken daga masu bincike na ƙasar Kamaru ya yi ƙarin haske kan muhimman bayanai da ke nuna yadda masu HIV ke fama da lalacewar hanta, kuma abubuwa daban-daban na ƙara illa ga lalacewar hanta.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše tša banyakišiši ba Cameroon di fana ka tshedimošo go datha ye bohlokwa ye e laetšago temogo ya tshenyego ya sebete go balwetši ba HIV, le mabaka a go fapafapana ao a oketšago kotsi ya bona ya tshenyego ya sebete.
Amharic: ይህ የካሜሩናውያን ተመራማሪዎች ጥናት በኤችአይቪ ታማሚዎች ጉበት ላይ የሚያጋጥመውን ጉዳት እና  ጉበታቸው የሚጎዳበትን እድል የሚጨምሩ የተለያዩ ምክንያቶችን የሚያሳዩ ጠቃሚ መረጃዎች ላይ ብርሃን ፈንጥቋል፡፡

English: Having this information may help in the management of liver damage in HIV patients.
Luganda: Okubeera n’obubaka buno kuyinza okuyamba mu nzijanjaba y’obuzibu bw’okukosebwa kw’ekibumba mu balwadde ba HIV.
Yoruba: Bí a bá ní irú ìfitónilétí yìí, ó ṣe é ṣe kí ó ran ìṣàkóso àìlera ẹ̀dọ̀ nínú fún àwọn tí wọ́n ní àrùn HIV.
Zulu: Ukubakhona kwalolu lwazi kungasiza ukunqanda ukubhebhetheka kwesifo esikhahlameza isibindi kwabane ne-HIV.
Hausa: Samun wannan bayanin na iya taimakawa wajen kula da lalacewar hanta a tsakanin masu HIV.
Northern Sotho: Go ba le tshedimošo ye go ka thuša go laoleng tshenyego ya sebete go balwetši ba HIV.
Amharic: ይህንን መረጃ ማግኘቱ በኤችአይቪ በሽተኞች ላይ የጉበት ጉዳትን ለመቆጣጠር ሊያግዝ ይችላል፡፡
